# Bulex Plombier

Bulex Plombier provides heating and plumbing services in Belgium as an authorized Bulex partner.

The public website is available in English and Dutch. The default language is English.

## Main pages

- English home: `/en`
- Dutch home: `/nl`
- Services: `/en/services` and `/nl/diensten`
- Heating solutions: `/en/solutions` and `/nl/oplossingen`
- Service areas: `/en/service-areas` and `/nl/loodgieter`
- Advice: `/en/advice` and `/nl/blog`
- Contact: `/en/contact` and `/nl/contact`

Services include boiler repair and maintenance, heating installation, water heaters, plumbing installation and water-leak repair. Availability is confirmed for each address when an enquiry is reviewed.

The production URL and sitemap are enabled only after launch configuration is complete. Do not infer a production domain or contact address from this file.
